The angle of projection of a projectile for which horizontal range and height attain same magnitude is

(A) tan^(− 1)(2)

Solution:

(u^2sin^2θ)/(2 g) = (u^2sin2θ)/g

⇒ (sin^2θ)/2 = 2sinθcosθ
⇒ (sinθ)/(cosθ) = 4 ⇒ tanθ = 4
